mapper.select:
with DYGLF as ( select DISTINCT a.FINPROD_ID ,CASE WHEN CORORG IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END CORORG from (select m.FINPROD_ID, case when m.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' then m.ISSUER else m.FINANCIER end org_code FROM FIN_PRODUCT m INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON m.FINPROD_ID=fpt.FINPROD_ID AND fpt.BRANCH=0 AND ( (fpt.TYPE_8 ='F06' and fpt.TYPE_6 IN('P01','P11')) OR ( fpt.TYPE_8 ='F01' AND fpt.TYPE_6 ='B18'))) a left join (SELECT ORG_NO,COUNT(COR_ORGID) AS CORORG FROM INF_ORG_CORRELATION WHERE ORG_NO <> COR_ORGID GROUP BY ORG_NO) b ON a.org_code=b.ORG_NO )
,CASH_INFO AS ( SELECT max(EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE,FINPROD_ID,CALC_TYPE FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE GROUP BY FINPROD_ID,CALC_TYPE )
,FIN_CASH_PLAN_COST AS ( /**还本计划**/ SELECT CASH_ID,FINPROD_ID ,PAY_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN fop WHERE fop.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F01','F07','F18') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_INFO fop2 WHERE fop2.CASH_TYPE_1 = '01' AND fop2.CASH_TYPE_2 ='C01' AND fop.CASH_ID =fop2.CASH_ID ) ) ,FIN_CASH_PLAN_RATE AS ( /**付息计划**/ SELECT CASH_ID,FINPROD_ID , PAY_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN fop WHERE fop.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F01','F07','F18') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_INFO fop2 WHERE fop2.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' AND fop2.CASH_TYPE_2 ='C02' AND fop.CASH_ID =fop2.CASH_ID ) ) ,COST_AST_PAYDATE AS ( /**距还本支付日在7个交易日以内的债券项目类资产**/ SELECT FINPROD_ID,PAY_DATE FROM ( SELECT m.FINPROD_ID,M.VDATE,y.PAY_DATE,NVL(M.CALENDAR_ID,'01') CALENDAR_ID ,rank() over(PARTITION BY m.FINPROD_ID ORDER BY y.PAY_DATE asc) AS rowno from FIN_PRODUCT m INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN_COST y ON y.FINPROD_ID=m.FINPROD_ID WHERE y.PAY_DATE >=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY y.PAY_DATE ASC ) WHERE rowno=1 ) ,RATE_AST_PAYDATE AS ( /**距付息支付日在7个交易日以内的债券项目类资产**/ SELECT FINPROD_ID,PAY_DATE FROM ( SELECT m.FINPROD_ID,M.VDATE,y.PAY_DATE,NVL(M.CALENDAR_ID,'01') CALENDAR_ID ,rank() over(PARTITION BY m.FINPROD_ID ORDER BY y.PAY_DATE asc) AS rowno from FIN_PRODUCT m INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN_RATE y ON y.FINPROD_ID=m.FINPROD_ID WHERE y.PAY_DATE >=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY y.PAY_DATE ASC ) WHERE rowno=1 ) ,FIN_OPEN_RULE_TEMP AS ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT CASH_ID,OPEN_TYPE,OPEN_MODE,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CASH_ID ORDER BY OPEN_TYPE DESC) rowno FROM FIN_OPEN_RULE) WHERE rowno=1 ) ,PLAN_AST_REPDATE AS ( /**距可赎回日在10个交易日以上计划类资产(高频开放，高频默认1)**/ select n.FINPROD_ID,DATE'${valDate}'+1 AS OPEN_VDATE from FIN_PRODUCT m INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO n ON n.FINPROD_ID = m.FINPROD_ID and m.FINPROD_TYPE2='F17' AND n.CASH_TYPE_1 = '01' AND n.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C01' /**这里为了申赎不同频,规则表两条记录，优先取赎回的，申购有可能是高频的，赎回是定期的**/ INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE_TEMP r ON r.CASH_ID = n.CASH_ID AND r.OPEN_MODE = '02' /**距可赎回日在10个交易日以上计划类资产(非高频开放)**/ UNION ALL SELECT FINPROD_ID,OPEN_VDATE FROM ( SELECT m.FINPROD_ID,M.VDATE,y.OPEN_VDATE,NVL(M.CALENDAR_ID,'01') CALENDAR_ID ,rank() over(PARTITION BY m.FINPROD_ID ORDER BY y.OPEN_VDATE asc) AS rowno from FIN_PRODUCT m INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO n ON n.FINPROD_ID=m.FINPROD_ID AND n.CASH_TYPE_1='01' AND n.CASH_TYPE_2='C01' AND M.FINPROD_TYPE2 ='F17' INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE_TEMP r ON r.CASH_ID = n.CASH_ID AND r.OPEN_MODE <> '02' INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN y ON y.CASH_ID=r.CASH_ID AND r.OPEN_TYPE=y.OPEN_TYPE WHERE y.OPEN_VDATE >=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY y.OPEN_VDATE ASC ) WHERE rowno=1 ) ,STOCK_WIND_DATE AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m1.SHARES_ID,m1.TRADE_STATUS FROM mst_share_price m1 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mst_share_price m2 WHERE m1.SHARES_ID =m2.SHARES_ID AND m1.DEAL_DATE <m2.DEAL_DATE AND m2.DEAL_DATE <=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') ) )
, FLOW_LIMITED_ASSET AS ( /**流动性受限资产**/ SELECT FPT.FINPROD_ID, 'Y' IS_FLOW_LIMITED FROM FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RSK_SPECIFIC_ASSET_TYPE RSAT WHERE RSAT.IS_FLOW_LIMITED = 'Y'
) AND FPT.TYPE_9||'_'||FPT.TYPE_10||'_'||FPT.TYPE_11||'_'||FPT.TYPE_12 != '___' ) , IS_LIQUIDITY1_ASSET AS ( /**是否无活跃交易市场**/ SELECT FPT.FINPROD_ID, 'Y' IS_LIQUIDITY1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RSK_SPECIFIC_ASSET_TYPE RSAT WHERE RSAT.IS_LIQUIDITY1 = 'Y'
) AND FPT.TYPE_9||'_'||FPT.TYPE_10||'_'||FPT.TYPE_11||'_'||FPT.TYPE_12 != '___' ) , IS_LIQUIDITY2_ASSET AS ( /**是否不具备活跃交易市场**/ SELECT FPT.FINPROD_ID, 'Y' IS_LIQUIDITY2 FROM FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RSK_SPECIFIC_ASSET_TYPE RSAT WHERE RSAT.IS_LIQUIDITY2 = 'Y'
) AND FPT.TYPE_9||'_'||FPT.TYPE_10||'_'||FPT.TYPE_11||'_'||FPT.TYPE_12 != '___' ) , IS_LIQUIDITY3_ASSET AS ( /**是否7个工作日可变现资产**/ SELECT FPT.FINPROD_ID, 'Y' IS_LIQUIDITY3 FROM FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RSK_SPECIFIC_ASSET_TYPE RSAT WHERE RSAT.IS_LIQUIDITY3 = 'Y'
) AND FPT.TYPE_9||'_'||FPT.TYPE_10||'_'||FPT.TYPE_11||'_'||FPT.TYPE_12 != '___' ) , IS_LIQUIDITY4_ASSET AS ( /**是否不良资产**/ SELECT FPT.FINPROD_ID, 'Y' IS_BADASSET FROM FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RSK_SPECIFIC_ASSET_TYPE RSAT WHERE RSAT.IS_BADASSET = 'Y'
) AND FPT.TYPE_9||'_'||FPT.TYPE_10||'_'||FPT.TYPE_11||'_'||FPT.TYPE_12 != '___' )
, IS_EXIST_RECAST AS ( SELECT DISTINCT FP.FINPROD_ID, 'Y' IS_EXIST_REC_AST FROM ( SELECT FINPROD_ID FROM ( SELECT prp.FINPROD_ID,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY FINPROD_ID ORDER BY CDATE DESC) AS RANKNO FROM PTL_RECE_POSITION prp INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON prp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE prp.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND PRP.AMOUNT > 0 AND cdate <= date'${valDate}' AND nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID, 'null') = 'null' AND PRP.FINPROD_ID LIKE 'F01_%' ) WHERE RANKNO=1 ) RA INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON FP.FINPROD_ID = RA.FINPROD_ID )
select m.FINPROD_ID finprodId, m.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, nvl(m.FINPROD_NAME,m.FINPROD_ABBR) finprodName, m.VDATE, m.MDATE, m.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, m.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, m.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, m.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, m.ISSUE_TYPE issueType, n.INVEST_NATURE investNature, n.IS_SEVEN_DAY_CASHABLE isSevenDayCashable, n.IS_OPEN_EVERYDAY isOpenEveryDay, n.BOND_RISK_TYPE bondRiskType, y.TYPE_4 type4, y.TYPE_5 type5, y.TYPE_8 type6, y.TYPE_6 type7, y.TYPE_7 typeSeven, y.TYPE_9 type9, y.TYPE_10 type10, y.TYPE_11 type11, y.TYPE_12 type12, s.REP_ASSET_TYPE repAssetDept,
RAE.REP_SHARES_TYPE stockShareType, swd.TRADE_STATUS stockTradeStatus, pard.OPEN_VDATE astLastRedempDate, cap.PAY_DATE astLastRebackDate, rap.PAY_DATE astLastPayDate,
ZtPingji.GRADE_RESULT bodyGradeType, ZxPingji.GRADE_RESULT bondGradeType, m.ISSUER_CODE as issuerCode, Mingdan.LIST_LEVEL listLevel, DYGLF.CORORG as isCorOrg
, m.IS_SUS isSus , m.IS_RIGHT isRight , cash.EFF_DATE vdateLast , cash.CALC_TYPE calcType
, PFP.IS_CAN_DRAW_IN_ADVANCE isCanDrawInAdvance
, NVL(RSAT.IS_FLOW_LIMITED, 'N') isFlowLimited , NVL(RSAT1.IS_LIQUIDITY1, 'N') isLiquidity1 , NVL(RSAT2.IS_LIQUIDITY2, 'N') isLiquidity2 , NVL(RSAT3.IS_LIQUIDITY3, 'N') isLiquidity3 , NVL(RSAT4.IS_BADASSET, 'N') isBadAsset
, NVL(IER.IS_EXIST_REC_AST, 'N') isExistRecAst
, MCIA.CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE customerObjType , rsatt.IS_UNLISTEDEQUITY isUnEquity ,decode(n.IS_INADVANCE,null,'N',n.IS_INADVANCE) isInAdvance from (select FIN_PRODUCT.* ,case FINPROD_TYPE2 WHEN 'F01' THEN ISSUER WHEN 'F06' THEN manager WHEN 'F07' THEN ISSUER WHEN 'F10' THEN ISSUER WHEN 'F18' THEN financier WHEN 'F17' THEN manager WHEN 'F32' THEN ISSUER WHEN 'F37' THEN financier ELSE null end as ISSUER_CODE from FIN_PRODUCT) m inner join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD n on m.FINPROD_ID=n.FINPROD_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE y on m.FINPROD_ID=y.FINPROD_ID and y.BRANCH='0'
left join STOCK_WIND_DATE swd on m.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=swd.SHARES_ID and m.FINPROD_TYPE2='F10' left join PLAN_AST_REPDATE pard on pard.FINPROD_ID=m.FINPROD_ID left join COST_AST_PAYDATE cap on cap.FINPROD_ID=m.FINPROD_ID left join RATE_AST_PAYDATE rap on rap.FINPROD_ID=m.FINPROD_ID
left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT PFP on m.FINPROD_ID = PFP.FINPROD_ID
left join FLOW_LIMITED_ASSET RSAT on m.FINPROD_ID = RSAT.FINPROD_ID left join IS_LIQUIDITY1_ASSET RSAT1 on m.FINPROD_ID = RSAT1.FINPROD_ID left join IS_LIQUIDITY2_ASSET RSAT2 on m.FINPROD_ID = RSAT2.FINPROD_ID left join IS_LIQUIDITY3_ASSET RSAT3 on m.FINPROD_ID = RSAT3.FINPROD_ID left join IS_LIQUIDITY4_ASSET RSAT4 on m.FINPROD_ID = RSAT4.FINPROD_ID
left join IS_EXIST_RECAST IER on m.FINPROD_ID = IER.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD MCIA ON MCIA.CUSTOMER_ID = m.ISSUER_CODE
left join REP_ASSET_DEPT s on m.FINPROD_ID=s.REP_FINPROD_ID left JOIN REP_ASSET_EQUITY RAE ON RAE.REP_FINPROD_ID =m.FINPROD_ID left join (SELECT LIST_LEVEL,LIST_DETAIL_ID FROM (SELECT n.LIST_LEVEL,m.LIST_DETAIL_ID,rank() over( partition BY LIST_DETAIL_ID ORDER BY LIST_LEVEL) AS rowno FROM RSK_ACCESS_LIST_DETAIL m INNER JOIN RSK_ACCESS_LIST n ON m.LIST_ID =n.LIST_ID AND m.LIST_DETAIL_ID IS NOT null AND m.LIST_DATE <=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') AND n.LIST_LEVEL IN ('01','02') AND m.LIST_DETAIL_TYPE='02') WHERE rowno=1 ) Mingdan ON Mingdan.LIST_DETAIL_ID=m.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT tempData.O_CODE,tempData.GRADE_RESULT FROM (SELECT A41.O_CODE,A41.GRADE_RESULT,rank() over( partition by A41.O_CODE order by A41.GRADE_DATE desc, A41.GRADE_RESULT DESC) AS rowNo FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING A41 WHERE O_TYPE='01' AND GRADE_DATE <=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd')) tempData WHERE tempData.rowNo=1 ) ZtPingji ON ZtPingji.O_CODE=m.ISSUER LEFT JOIN (SELECT tempData.O_CODE,tempData.GRADE_RESULT FROM (SELECT A41.O_CODE,A41.GRADE_RESULT,rank() over( partition by A41.O_CODE order by A41.GRADE_DATE desc, A41.GRADE_RESULT DESC) AS rowNo FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING A41 WHERE O_TYPE='02' AND GRADE_DATE <=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd')) tempData WHERE tempData.rowNo=1 ) ZxPingji ON ZxPingji.O_CODE=m.FINPROD_MARKET_ID left join DYGLF on m.FINPROD_ID=DYGLF.FINPROD_ID left join RSK_SPECIFIC_ASSET_TYPE rsatt on m.FINPROD_ID=rsatt.FINPROD_ID
left join CASH_INFO cash on cash.FINPROD_ID = m.FINPROD_ID
m.FINPROD_ID in

, null isSus , null isRight , null vdateLast , null calcType
, null isCanDrawInAdvance
, null isFlowLimited , null isLiquidity1 , null isLiquidity2 , null isLiquidity3 , null isBadAsset
, null isExistRecAst
, null customerObjType , null isUnEquity ,'N' as isInAdvance from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT m inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE y on m.FINPROD_ID=y.FINPROD_ID and m.BRANCH='0' and y.BRANCH='0' and m.FINPROD_TYPE <> 'F21' left join REP_ASSET_DEPT s on m.FINPROD_ID=s.REP_FINPROD_ID left JOIN REP_ASSET_EQUITY RAE ON RAE.REP_FINPROD_ID =m.FINPROD_ID
